Question (letter number: 57-D/491/2026/43 (05 August 2026)
Document number 40 (16 July 2026)

Questioning Member: Dr. Ahmed Shamheed, Member for Hulhumale' Dhekunu constituency

Question:

On how many islands of the Maldives is practical work on airport development currently under way, and how much additional money is estimated to be needed to complete that work?

Answer:

Development work on 5 airports, which have been contracted under the supervision of this Ministry, is currently under way. This work is progressing at various stages. And it is not considered that money beyond the allocated budget will be needed to complete these projects. However, as the L. Isdhoo-Kalaidhoo airport project has not yet been contracted, the MVR 600 million needed for that project has now been included and arranged in the budget.
